posts.title: Printing Press and the Rise of Consumer-Shaped Software
posts.description: Printing Press lets the consumer of an API synthesize the exact interface they need. I built a cost-aware Sumble CLI with it, which got me thinking about consumer-shaped software and a world where agents orchestrate while deterministic harnesses compile.
